channel.title: Social Media Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Social Media Today (socialmediatoday.com)

item.title: FBI investigates X over nude images generated by Grok
item.description: The artificial intelligence platform was also used to generate professional complaints, according to a report from 404 Media in collaboration with Court Watch.

item.title: Instagram’s connected TV app comes to US Google TV devices
item.description: The expansion will allow users to watch Reels on their televisions and provide big screen viewing capabilities for Instagram content.

item.title: Google rolls out updates to image and video tool Flow AI
item.description: New features include an updated user interface, more intuitive editing tools and the ability to generate videos from images using text prompts.

item.title: Snapchat announces new awards show designed to spotlight creators
item.description: The Snappys will be hosted by Snap Star Matt Friend and include a lifetime achievement award for DJ Khaled.

item.title: Instagram will alert parents when teens search for self-harm content
item.description: The new safety measure will roll out on the Meta-owned app in the U.S., Canada, the U.K. and Australia over the coming weeks.

item.title: Meta takes legal action against celeb-bait scammers
item.description: The new filings are part of a larger effort to protect users by taking stronger legal measures against scam activity.

item.title: Google introduces next iteration of AI image generation model
item.description: With Nano Banana 2, the company merged the capabilities of Nano Banana and Nano Banana Pro, combining all the tools into a single app.

item.title: X adds two aspect ratio options for in-stream ads
item.description: The new options are aligned with the more compact formatting style popularized across other apps.

item.title: Threads tests simplified DM connection in-stream
item.description: The new process is being tested in the U.S. and Canada, and allows users to activate direct messaging by typing in a post.

item.title: Creators express frustration with Instagram’s latest AI experiment
item.description: A shopping test in the Meta-owned app is being criticized for displaying products influencers don’t endorse and tags that could compete with pre-existing brand deals.
